utility_fit: same two chronological donor-only train blocks as v1, recomputed for each actual new readout
local_gate: empirical MAE and MSE gain both positive and at least 2/3 represented donor turbines jointly benefit
selection_score: minimum of realized two-block cell MAE gain and query-specific empirical MAE gain
composition: disabled for primary and matched legacy no-composition control; legacy composition was inactive in all 9 runs
outer_validation: one predeclared exploratory evaluation per fold; not an independent confirmation set
stop_rule: do not tune thresholds, seeds, neighborhood or alpha after outer results; do not automatically expand runs
